verses.restored: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

familiar.text: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

modern.text: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.

modern.text: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.
